reference_mass_kg.source: Guerster & Walter 2017 Eq.17; same mass assumed for all three calibration flights

area_m2.source: Three 2012 peak speeds; same Cd(M); results.json calibration
area_m2.interpretation: Constant fitted effective area throughout translation; attitude does not change this area.

cylinder.status: geometry design assumptions, not anthropometric measurements
cylinder.reference_pose: Belly-down, horizontal longitudinal cylinder axis perpendicular to vertical z; Guerster & Walter 2017 flight attitude section.

moment_coefficients.status: aircraft magnitude analogy; not human measurements
moment_coefficients.bias_source: NASA CR-186030 printed p6, Figs12-13: amplitudes .040/.063/.078
moment_coefficients.damping_source: NASA TP1538 Table III printed p81: Cnr=-1.02 at alpha=40 deg; Cnomega=-Cnr

opening_height_m.status: source transferred to sea-level landing scenario

inflation_s.source: T-11 approximately 6 seconds provides scale, not an 8-second measurement

landing_target_mps.source: T-11 <18ft/s=5.4864m/s at 181.4kg; resize drag area for 190kg

free_g_limit.status: design screen, not NASA-certified human limit
free_g_limit.source: NASA-STD-3001 Vol 2 Rev C sec 6.5.1 fig 4 p58: deconditioned positive Gx, 30/90/150 s: 78.5/49.0/39.2 m/s2 (~8/5/4 g). Non-deconditioned positive Gx 5/300 s: 157/73.5 m/s2. Restraints and counterpressure garment assumed; reference scale only, not a skydiving limit.

opening_g_limit.status: design screen, not NASA-certified human limit

spin_g_limit.status: chosen local 1-second radial acceleration design screen; not a medical limit and not inferred from translational NASA limits

recovery_k_limit.status: design screening assumption, not a NASA aerodynamic recovery-temperature rating
recovery_k_limit.source: NASA Spacewalk Spacesuit Basics: approximately -250 to +250 F, or 116.48 to 394.26 K environmental range; select 390 K near the high end as a conditional proxy

landing_mps_limit.status: design margin over 5.5m/s target, not universal injury threshold

inflation_function.status: lowest-degree polynomial satisfying S(0)=0, S(1)=1, S_prime(0)=S_prime(1)=0; design interpolation, not manufacturer measurement

load_atmosphere_extension.method: Continue final lapse-rate segment, hydrostatic pressure and ideal-gas density; use existing geopotential conversion
load_atmosphere_extension.status: mathematical extrapolation, not validated upper-atmosphere data; excluded from all other analyses

spin_response.status: timely detection and completed posture adjustment assumed within 1s from bias onset; frozen rho and v; independent local onset response at each trajectory point
spin_response.pitch: conditionally neglected for stable reference pose and small initial pitch perturbations
